description: Add cross-project portfolio management to Kanboard with portfolios, milestones, unified task views, dependency visualization, and supporting API/controllers/hooks.

userStories.title: Bootstrap the Portfolio plugin entry point and package structure
userStories.description: Create the initial plugin shell so Kanboard can discover the plugin, load translations, and expose the expected top-level directories for subsequent implementation work.
acceptanceCriteria: Plugin.php defines plugin metadata including name, description, version, homepage, author, and compatible Kanboard version.
onStartup() loads translations from Locale/ for the current Kanboard language.
The repository contains the planned top-level plugin directories needed by the implementation spec (Schema, Model, Controller, Template, Asset, Locale, Test, and related support folders).
PHP syntax checks pass for the new bootstrap files and no existing project guidance files are broken by the scaffold.

userStories.title: Add version 1 schema migrations for all supported databases
userStories.description: Implement append-only migration files for SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, and PostgreSQL that create the four plugin tables and their indexes exactly as defined in the spec.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema/Sqlite.php, Schema/Mysql.php, and Schema/Postgres.php each define VERSION = 1 and a version_1(PDO $pdo) function.
The migrations create portfolios, portfolio_has_projects, milestones, and milestone_has_tasks with the required columns, primary keys, foreign keys, and indexes from the spec.
The migration code is append-only and does not modify prior version_N() functions after creation.
Relevant migration tests or verification steps are added and PHP linting remains clean.

userStories.title: Register core services in the plugin container
userStories.description: Wire the plugin's DI container entries so models, helper, and validator can be resolved consistently by controllers, hooks, and API callbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Plugin.php registers container services for portfolioModel, portfolioProjectModel, milestoneModel, milestoneTaskModel, dependencyModel, portfolioTaskModel, portfolioHelper, and portfolioValidator.
Each service resolves to the expected namespaced class under Kanboard\Plugin\Portfolio.
The service registration does not introduce unused or conflicting container keys.
PHP linting passes and any bootstrap coverage needed for service construction is added.
userStories.notes: Spec refs: Appendix A DI registration block.

userStories.title: Implement PortfolioModel CRUD and validation behavior
userStories.description: Build the model responsible for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting portfolios with the exact return conventions and name uniqueness rules defined in the spec.
acceptanceCriteria: PortfolioModel supports create, getById, getByName, getAll, update, and remove using PicoDb queries only.
Portfolio creation trims and validates names, enforces uniqueness, and stores created_at and updated_at timestamps.
Update and remove operations follow Kanboard-style return values (true/false or null) without writing to Kanboard core tables.
Unit tests cover successful CRUD, duplicate-name rejection, empty-name rejection, not-found behavior, and cascade effects expected from schema constraints.

userStories.title: Implement PortfolioProjectModel membership management
userStories.description: Add model logic for adding and removing projects from portfolios and listing memberships with ordering metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: PortfolioProjectModel implements add, remove, getProjects, getPortfolios, and any helper methods needed to resolve project IDs for a portfolio.
Adding a project verifies that both the portfolio and project exist and prevents duplicate membership rows.
Removing a project from a portfolio also removes that project's tasks from milestones in the same portfolio in the model layer.
Unit tests cover add/remove success, duplicate rejection, ordering, reverse lookup, and milestone cleanup behavior.

userStories.title: Implement MilestoneModel CRUD and progress calculation
userStories.description: Create milestone persistence and progress computation including target-date parsing, at-risk detection, and overdue detection.
acceptanceCriteria: MilestoneModel implements create, getById, getByPortfolioId, update, remove, and getProgress using PicoDb-compatible queries.
Milestone names are unique within a portfolio, target dates accept YYYY-MM-DD or timestamp input, and milestone status values match the spec.
Progress calculation returns total, completed, percent, blocked_count, is_at_risk, is_overdue, and target_date with the documented semantics.
Unit tests cover CRUD, portfolio-scoped name uniqueness, date parsing, zero-task progress, partial progress, completed progress, at-risk, and overdue cases.

userStories.title: Implement MilestoneTaskModel milestone-to-task membership
userStories.description: Add the model that links tasks to milestones, validates portfolio membership, and supports both forward and reverse lookups.
acceptanceCriteria: MilestoneTaskModel implements add, remove, getTasks, and getMilestones using PicoDb queries and Kanboard task/project lookups.
add() rejects tasks whose project is not part of the milestone's portfolio and prevents duplicate milestone-task membership rows.
getTasks() returns enriched task data including project, column, assignee, membership metadata, and critical-path flag fields described in the spec.
Unit tests cover valid add/remove flows, duplicate rejection, invalid portfolio-project membership, enriched retrieval, and reverse milestone lookup.

userStories.title: Implement DependencyModel queries for dependencies, blocked tasks, and blocking tasks
userStories.description: Build the read-side dependency model over Kanboard's existing task_has_links table so the plugin can expose portfolio-scoped dependency information.
acceptanceCriteria: DependencyModel can resolve the configured dependency link types dynamically from the links table and scope queries to a portfolio's projects.
getDependencies(), getBlockedTasks(), and getBlockingTasks() return the documented payload fields including project names, resolution flags, and blocker lists.
The implementation handles cross-project-only filtering and does not write any dependency data to plugin or core tables.
Unit tests cover no-dependency cases, cross-project filtering, resolved-vs-unresolved dependencies, and blocker/blocking task discovery.

userStories.title: Implement dependency graph, critical path, and task event reactions
userStories.description: Extend the dependency model with graph-ready output, longest-chain critical path calculation, and event-driven unblock detection.
acceptanceCriteria: DependencyModel implements getCriticalPath(), getGraph(), onTaskClosed(), onTaskOpened(), and onLinkChanged() with behavior matching the spec.
Critical-path logic builds a directed graph from unresolved active dependency edges, performs topological processing, and handles cycles defensively.
Closing a blocking task can fire portfolio.dependency.resolved with the documented event payload when cross-project dependent tasks become unblocked.
Unit tests cover linear and branching critical paths, empty graph behavior, graph payload shape, event firing when dependencies resolve, and no-op cases.

userStories.title: Implement PortfolioTaskModel unified task queries and overview metrics
userStories.description: Create the portfolio-wide task query model that supports filtering, sorting, pagination, blocked status calculation, aggregate counts, and dashboard summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: PortfolioTaskModel implements getTasks(), getCounts(), and getOverview() with the filters, sorting options, and pagination rules documented in the spec.
Returned task records include computed blocked fields and enriched project/column/assignee metadata needed by list and dashboard views.
Overview responses include project_count, task_counts, milestone health summaries, and critical_path_length consistent with the spec.
Unit tests cover filtering by status, assignee, project, milestone, dependency presence, count aggregation, sorting, pagination, and overview composition.

userStories.title: Register the full JSON-RPC API surface and API access map
userStories.description: Expose all model capabilities through Kanboard's JSON-RPC procedure handler with the exact method names, parameters, and access rules from the spec.
acceptanceCriteria: Plugin.php registers all 28 JSON-RPC procedures with the method names and callback wiring defined in the spec.
Write procedures are protected by the API access map at Role::APP_MANAGER while read procedures remain available to APP_USER by default.
API callbacks delegate to the implemented models without introducing incompatible return types or custom error semantics.
Integration coverage or targeted API tests verify representative read and write methods and PHP linting remains clean.
userStories.notes: Spec refs: section 4, section 5.2, Appendix A, Appendix B.

userStories.title: Implement portfolio list and portfolio CRUD web flows
userStories.description: Create the initial portfolio web UI for listing, creating, editing, and removing portfolios using standard Kanboard controller and template patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: PortfolioListController::index() and PortfolioModificationController create/edit/remove flows are implemented with the documented routes and role restrictions.
Templates under Template/portfolio/ render list, create, edit, and remove screens with escaped output, translated strings, and CSRF protection on POST forms.
Successful create and update actions redirect to the expected portfolio pages and failure cases surface translated error messages.
Integration tests cover list rendering, create form display, successful create submit, access denial for APP_USER, and remove confirmation flow.

userStories.title: Implement portfolio project membership settings UI
userStories.description: Add the settings screen and controller actions that let managers add or remove projects from a portfolio and review current membership ordering.
acceptanceCriteria: PortfolioModificationController::settings(), addProject(), and removeProject() are implemented with the documented routes, CSRF checks, and role rules.
Template/portfolio/settings.php shows current member projects and supports adding and removing projects using translated labels and escaped output.
Removing a project through the UI triggers the same membership and milestone cleanup behavior as the model layer contract.
Integration tests cover viewing the settings page, adding a project, removing a project, and unauthorized access rejection.

userStories.title: Implement portfolio dashboard and unified task list views
userStories.description: Build the core portfolio viewing experience including the dashboard summary and the filterable task list across portfolio projects.
acceptanceCriteria: PortfolioViewController::show() and tasks() are implemented and registered to the documented routes.
Template/portfolio/show.php and Template/portfolio/tasks.php render overview metrics, project summaries, milestone health data, and filtered task results from PortfolioTaskModel.
The task list supports the documented filters, sorting, pagination, and blocked indicators using escaped output and translated labels.
Integration tests cover the portfolio dashboard and unified task list pages with representative data.

userStories.title: Implement aggregate board and timeline views
userStories.description: Add the remaining portfolio overview pages that present active work in a board-style aggregate layout and timeline/Gantt-style format.
acceptanceCriteria: PortfolioViewController::board() and timeline() are implemented with the documented routes and data loading behavior.
Template/portfolio/board.php and the timeline view render aggregate project data without using template overrides or cross-project writes.
Required formatter or asset support is added for board/timeline rendering, including bundled JS usage where the spec expects it.
Integration coverage verifies the board and timeline routes render successfully with representative portfolio data.

userStories.title: Implement milestone web controllers and milestone templates
userStories.description: Create the milestone UI for listing, viewing, creating, editing, deleting, and assigning tasks to cross-project milestones.
acceptanceCriteria: MilestoneController implements index, show, create, save, edit, update, remove, delete, addTask, and removeTask with the documented routes and role restrictions.
Templates under Template/milestone/ render milestone lists, detail views, forms, and delete confirmation using escaped output and translated strings.
AJAX or form flows for adding and removing tasks from milestones call the model validation that ensures task projects belong to the portfolio.
Integration tests cover the milestone CRUD lifecycle and representative task membership actions.

userStories.title: Implement dependency web controllers, templates, and graph endpoint
userStories.description: Create the dependency-focused pages for graph visualization, blocked task review, and critical path display.
acceptanceCriteria: DependencyController implements graph(), graphData(), blocked(), and criticalPath() for the documented routes and AJAX use cases.
Templates under Template/dependency/ render graph, blocked, and critical path pages with safe output and translated text.
The graph data endpoint returns the structured nodes/edges payload expected by the bundled D3.js graph component.
Integration tests cover dependency graph page rendering, graph JSON access, blocked tasks view, and critical path view.

userStories.title: Add template hooks, widgets, helper utilities, and board blocked-status preloading
userStories.description: Integrate portfolio information into existing Kanboard pages through hooks and add helper logic needed to render widgets efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: Plugin.php registers the dashboard, board, task detail, project sidebar, header dropdown, config sidebar, CSS, and JS hooks listed in the spec.

Widget templates under Template/widget/ render dashboard portfolio links, at-risk milestones, board blocked indicators, task milestone info, dependency snippets, project sidebar data, and creation dropdown links.
Dependency blocked-status data for board cards is preloaded or cached to avoid an obvious N+1 query pattern during board rendering.
Integration tests verify representative hook output such as the board blocker indicator and task sidebar milestone widget.
userStories.notes: Spec refs: sections 2.1 Helper, 6.1, 6.2, 6.3, Appendix A.

userStories.title: Add dependency-resolved notifications, automatic actions, and custom notification type
userStories.description: Implement the event-driven automation pieces that notify users or comment on tasks when cross-project blockers are resolved.
acceptanceCriteria: Plugin.php registers the portfolio.dependency.resolved custom event and wires task.close/task.open/task_internal_link events to DependencyModel handlers.
Action/NotifyDependencyResolved.php and Action/CommentDependencyResolved.php implement the documented behavior for notifying assignees and adding task comments.
Notification/DependencyResolvedType.php and its template register and render the custom notification payload correctly.
Tests cover event dispatch and the expected side effects of the automatic actions at the model or integration level.
userStories.notes: Spec refs: section 7, section 12.2, Appendix A.

userStories.title: Implement configuration UI, task search filter, localization, and asset polish
userStories.description: Complete the user-facing polish work by adding plugin settings, the portfolio task search filter, translation coverage, and final CSS/JS asset wiring.
acceptanceCriteria: The plugin exposes the documented portfolio_* configuration settings through Kanboard config storage and a settings UI entry in the config sidebar.
Filter/TaskPortfolioFilter.php enables portfolio-based task search behavior consistent with the spec.
Locale/en_US/translations.php includes the required user-visible strings and all templates/controllers use t('...') consistently.
portfolio.css and any remaining JS files are wired in with portfolio-prefixed CSS classes, and relevant tests plus project quality checks remain green.
userStories.notes: Spec refs: sections 2.1 Filter/Asset/Locale, 8, 13, Appendix C.
